note: escalations is the ratchet. It counts write-shaped capabilities the table grants and the hardcoded checks deny — each one becomes a real privilege the day crm7 migration 20260905000000 is applied and user_has_capability() starts answering. The ratchet only shrinks: a rise fails the gate, and a fall fails it too until re-banked, because a ratchet nobody re-banks stops ratcheting.
not_a_defect_count: A divergence is a question, not a defect. Either the table is wrong or the hardcoded check is, and deciding that is reconciliation work. This number sizes the work; it does not accuse either side.
